webster.text: Not having money, goods or estate sufficient to pay all debts; as an insolvent debtor.

more.text: Not sufficient to pay all the debts of the owner; as an insolvent estate.
A debtor unable to pay his debts.

example.quote: That the Power of Congress to pass uniform Laws concerning Bankruptcy shall only extend to Merchants and other Traders; and that the States respectively may pass Laws for the relief of other Insolvent Debtors.
example.cite: Ratification of the Constitution by the State of New York, July 26, 1788
